paragraphs.source_en: It was said that Lady Oeyo and Takechiyo's wet nurse, Lady Fuku, were somewhat at odds, one reason being Oeyo's excessive frugality. Having once tasted every manner of earthly misfortune, she remained notably plain in dress even now, when she held the exalted station of the shogun's wife. The servants said that the shogun was somewhat in awe of Oeyo and had therefore taken no concubine. Naruse Masanari, however, thought that perhaps Hidetada was genuinely content with this one wife.
